info.title: ListerCore Edu API
info.description: API REST de ListerCore Edu, generada desde los contratos gRPC (grpc-gateway). Cada ruta cuelga de la institución (`/api/v1/institutions/{institution_slug}`) y necesita el token de sesión en `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. El token se obtiene con `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in`.

tags.name: AcademicService
tags.description:
Metadata:
  authorization: Bearer <session token>   (every method)
  x-forwarded-for, x-user-agent           (as every lt-edu-api service)

Every request carries institution_slug: institution roles work on their own institution whatever it says; the
platform superadmin opens the one named. Staff roles read; director, academic coordinator and superadmin change.
Dates travel as YYYY-MM-DD. Failed calls return a gRPC status whose details hold one ltedu.common.v1.ErrorDetail

tags.name: AssessmentService
tags.description:
Coordinación sees and edits every sheet; each teacher grades their own areas or units; tutors fill the tutor's
sheet of their section and read its report cards; secretaría reads; families see closed report cards

tags.name: ClosingService
tags.description: Dirección and coordinación close; secretaría reads, prints the actas and exports

tags.name: AttendanceService
tags.description:
The office (dirección, coordinación, secretaría, auxiliares) scans and marks anyone; tutors mark their sections;
teachers take their classes; families see their children and send justifications

unit_ids.title: Institutes; empty enrolls every unit of the semester

grade.title: Empty when the kind has no grades (CEPRE)

action.title: create | update | delete | status | grant | revoke | other

changes_json.title: Detail as JSON ({"field": [before, after]}), "{}" when none

conclusions.title: term id → conclusion, for every term shown

averages.title: term id ("" for the whole period) → average, missing when there are no scores

comment.title: The tutor's descriptive conclusion of the term

enrollment_id.title:
Phase E7: the student's own grade (multigrade sections), the Religion exemption (its cells read EXO) and the
SIAGIE state of the grades: pending | exported | observed

units.title: Institutes: units of the plans in force; subject.curriculum_id is not set, grade_ids give the semester

unit_level_ids.title: Program (level) of each unit, same order as units

other_periods.title: Other periods of the institution, to copy sections from

relationship.title: mother | father | legal_guardian | grandparent | sibling | other

grantable_roles.title: Role codes this page can give in the institution's kind

self_user_id.title: The person asking, who cannot revoke their own access

id.title: Role assignment id, or invitation id when pending

since.title: RFC 3339: granted or invited at; last sign-in empty when never

season.title: CEPRE: summer | annual | semester | intensive | review | school | other

origin.title: Where the student comes from and the studies they bring

act_year.title: Acta: "N.° 003-2026" when generated, its newest version and state (pending | published | superseded | cancelled)

act_version_id.title: Phase E7: the newest signed version of the acta (empty until generated) and its state

dre.title: Official header (SIAGIE format): regional office, UGEL, modular code and the institution's logo (data URL)

final.title: The selected term is the last of the period: the annual levels and the final conclusions apply

term_count.title: Terms of the whole period (the card shows a column for each, filled up to the selected one)

tutor_id.title: Tutor of the section (staff), empty when none

program.title: EBA only: pebaja | literacy, and virtual | itinerant when attention_mode is distance

multigrade.title: EBA only: gathers students of several grades of the cycle; grade_id is the lowest

grading_scale.title: literal | vigesimal | score (fixed by the institution kind)

late_after_minutes.title: Attendance: minutes of tolerance after the first class, and the absence share (%) that raises an alert

dre.title:
Official data for the report card; unset on an update keeps what is stored. Logo: image data URL (PNG, JPG,
WebP or SVG, under 100 KB), "" removes it

management.title:
Tipo de gestión: public (no tuition; families pay the enrollment and the APAFA fee) | private. Unset on an
update keeps what is stored; turning public fails while open periods still have tuition in plans or owed

marks.title: Days that were not plain present, newest first

kind.title: area | workshop | tutoring | course | unit | efsrt
